name: The closer
summary: Time the hand-over and draw the end card: hook out, window and headers fade, gear mark, slogan pair, a Follow button that presses once, the footer and the 18+ line on AEON cards.
qualityBar: drawCloser matches the engine's closer() for bgi and aeon at six times from t0+0.2 to t0+2.8 (at most 40 differing pixels each)
Slogan: line 1 white and line 2 #19e08f by pixel colour counts in their rows, line 1 ends left of x 930, both lines always drawn together, text not a parameter
AEON closer writes both halves of the 18+ line, BGI none; footers are the brand URLs; nothing is drawn before t0
Follow button squeezes over 2.5 percent at the press (measured width), not with pressAt false, breathes, and the closer changes between frames 0.2 s apart
choreography/validateCloser numbers exact: leave t0-0.1..t0+0.3, press t0+1.9, end t0+3.1; plans with a short hold, a first-half closer, a missing META.brand or a late hook fail
Demo 8 s 1080x1920 silent (AEON variant): engine QC passes including slogan pair, Follow, footer and 18+ in the second half
